posts.title: Mindset shift
posts.description: In a panel at BCU Innovation Fest '26, I asked "are you confident you can get re-hired for your job today?" This question has helped me focus on keeping myself sharp in my career. Thinking of your career phases - before, during and after you've proven your value to your stakeholders, you need a shift in mindset at each phase change. Let's talk about that today.
